profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at SoFi
profile.summary: Software engineer specializing in analytics and marketing technology; background in data engineering and data science.

positions.title: Grader & Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Graded papers and other assignments for an upper-division course in Theoretical Syntax.
- Advised and assisted students in completing general coursework during weekly office hours.
- Met regularly with the instructor and other teaching assistants to assess grade distributions and set equitable standards of achievement.

positions.title: Subject Tutor
positions.description:
- Lead tutoring sessions of 1-4 students in a number of different courses spanning multiple disciplines:
- Theoretical Syntax 
- Formal Semantics 
- Phonology 
- Linear Algebra 
- Calculus 
- Measurable improvement in course performance for regularly attending students.
